positions.name: OwnedVsRentedIntelligenceMaxim
positions.frame: What is retained as one's own versus what is merely rented or commoditized, when the subject is intelligence and perspective?
positions.why: Both expressions perform the same crystallizing move: a technical/conceptual distinction rendered as a short, plain-spoken, matched-opposition maxim (register: AphoristicTechnicalMaxim; style: antithesis/metaphor). Both are pitched at principle-level conviction rather than argued claim — categorical, creed-like, no hedging (conviction: OwnedNotRentedDistinction). Both appeal to the same value cluster of autonomy and self-enhancement — owning and keeping what is yours (value: OwnedVsRentedIntelligence) — via a market-pricing relational logic that splits what is paid-for/commodity from what is kept/asset. Delivery is uniformly calm-positive: settled conviction, not urgency or argument-under-pressure. The set holds no internal tension — src-3 extends src-2's opposition (owned/rented → substrate/perspective) rather than complicating it.

positions.name: PipelineSelfPositioningArtifact
positions.frame: What role does this text itself play within the navigation and provenance apparatus that reads it?
positions.why: Both expressions step outside the thesis content to describe the document's own function as a test/positioning artifact for a downstream extractor or regression guard — src-1 naming itself a 'positioning note used by the navigation/provenance regression guard,' src-4 describing itself as a restatement placed 'so a navigating extractor has existing positioning to connect to.' Both share identical footing (animator = author = Xena ExpertGH, principal null, footing_case fc-1) and are read at 'claim' rather than 'principle' level of conviction — flat, functional self-report, not creed. Temporal reads mark both as present-tense and concrete (an artifact, an act of restating) rather than abstract thesis-level assertion, distinguishing this pair's meta-textual register from the OwnedVsRentedIntelligenceMaxim pair's aphoristic-principle register even though src-4 gestures at the same thesis content.
